periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 70 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, tapering toward the lower muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval geometry where the vertical height is significantly greater than the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward elongation, with the lowest point extending significantly below the geometric center of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow, flat U-shape along the posterior boundary of the transverse dark band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band occupies approximately 30% of the visible torso length at the lateral flank interface.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide spatial separation approximately equal to the horizontal width of the white cranial fur area between the ears.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, continuous convex curvature at the superior margins of the ears.
